title_en: Interim Measures on the Administration of Securities and Futures Investment Consulting

articles.content_en: These Measures are formulated to strengthen the administration of securities and futures investment consultancy activities and to protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors and the public interest.

Any entity or individual engaging in securities and futures investment consultancy business shall obtain the business license from the CSRC in accordance with the provisions of these Measures. No institution or individual may engage in any form of securities and futures investment consultancy business listed in Article 2 of these Measures without the permission of the CSRC.
Securities operating institutions, futures brokerage institutions and their staff engaging in securities and futures investment consultancy business beyond the scope of their own institutions shall comply with the provisions of these Measures.

Any entity or individual engaging in securities and futures investment consultancy business shall comply with relevant laws, regulations, rules and relevant provisions of the CSRC, and shall adhere to the principles of objectivity, fairness and good faith.

The CSRC and its authorized local securities and futures regulatory authorities (hereinafter referred to as the local regulatory offices (CSRC)) shall be responsible for the supervision and administration of securities and futures investment consultancy business and for the implementation of these Measures.

Securities operating institutions and futures brokerage institutions may apply to engage in securities and futures investment consultancy business beyond the scope of their own institutions only if they meet the conditions specified in Article 6 of these Measures.
Other institutions engaged in consultancy business may apply to concurrently engage in securities and futures investment consultancy business if they meet the conditions specified in Article 6 of these Measures.

Where there is any change in the business method, business premises, principal responsible person or business personnel with the qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy of a securities and futures investment consultancy institution, it shall submit a change report to the local regulatory office (CSRC) within five working days from the date of the change and go through the change procedures.

Persons engaged in securities and futures investment consultancy business must obtain the qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy and join a securities and futures investment consultancy institution with such qualification before they may engage in securities and futures investment consultancy business.
No person who has not obtained the qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy, or who has obtained such qualification but does not work in a securities and futures investment consultancy institution, may engage in securities and futures investment consultancy business.

Where a person who has obtained the qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy applies to practice, the securities and futures investment consultancy institution with which the person is associated shall submit an application to the local regulatory office (CSRC); after examination and consent, the local regulatory office (CSRC) shall report to the CSRC for examination and approval; if the practice is permitted, the CSRC shall issue a practice certificate.

A person who has obtained the practice qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy shall undergo the annual inspection of practice at the same time as the annual inspection of the securities and futures investment consultancy institution with which the person is associated. If a person has obtained the qualification for securities and futures investment consultancy but does not practice in a securities and futures investment consultancy institution, the qualification shall automatically cease to have effect after 18 months from the date of obtaining it.
A securities and futures investment consultant may not simultaneously practice in two or more securities and futures investment consultancy institutions.

Securities and futures investment consultancy institutions and their investment consultants shall provide securities and futures investment consultancy services to investors or clients with the prudence, honesty and diligence generally recognized in the industry.

Securities and futures investment consultancy institutions and their investment consultants shall use relevant information and materials completely, objectively and accurately to provide investment analysis, forecasts and suggestions to investors or clients, and shall not quote out of context or distort relevant information or materials; when quoting relevant information or materials, they shall indicate the source and the copyright holder.

Securities and futures investment consulting institutions and their investment consultants shall not provide investment analysis, forecasts or recommendations to investors or clients based on false information, market rumors or inside information.

When publishing investment consulting articles, reports or opinions in newspapers, radio, television or other media, securities and futures investment consultants must indicate the name of the securities and futures investment consulting institution to which they belong and their true personal name, and provide a full explanation of investment risks. Securities and futures investment consulting institutions must indicate the name, address, contact telephone number and contact person of the institution on the facsimile documents of securities and futures investment consulting provided to investors or clients.

When securities and futures investment consulting institutions co-sponsor or co-organize securities and futures investment consulting sections or programs with newspapers, radio, television stations, or conduct business cooperation with telecommunications service departments, they shall file records with the local securities regulatory office (CSRC). The filing materials shall include: the content of cooperation, start and end dates, section arrangement or program time slots, project leaders, etc., and shall be affixed with the seals of both parties.

Securities and futures investment consulting institutions shall be consistent in the investment analysis, forecasts or recommendations provided to different clients on the same issue.
When engaging in securities investment consulting business beyond the scope of the institution, a securities operating institution with self-operated business shall provide consistent consulting opinions to the public and its self-operated department on the same issue, and shall not mislead the public for the purpose of profiting from its self-operated business.

Securities operating institutions and futures brokerage institutions shall only use the securities and futures information briefs, express bulletins, updates and information systems compiled for internal use within the institution, and shall not provide them to the public through any means.
The underwriter or listing recommender of a company whose shares are publicly issued with the approval of the CSRC, and its affiliated securities investment consulting institution, shall not publish in public media the investment value analysis reports written for clients.

The CSRC and local securities regulatory offices (CSRC) have the right to conduct inspections of the business activities of securities and futures investment consulting institutions and investment consultants. The securities and futures investment consulting institutions and their investment consultants being inspected shall cooperate and shall not interfere with or obstruct the inspections.
The CSRC and local securities regulatory offices (CSRC) and their staff members shall take care to protect the trade secrets involved during the business inspections.
Securities and futures investment consulting institutions shall keep the investment consulting materials provided to investors or the public for two years from the date of provision.

The local securities regulatory office (CSRC) has the right, based on complaints or reports from investors or the public, to require securities and futures investment consulting institutions and their investment consultants to explain the circumstances and provide relevant materials.

Any unit or individual discovering that a securities and futures investment consulting institution, investment consultant or other institution or individual has violated the provisions of these Measures may lodge complaints and reports with the local securities regulatory office (CSRC).
The local securities regulatory office (CSRC) shall initiate an investigation into any violation of these Measures and report the investigation results to the CSRC for filing.

Anyone who engages in the securities and futures investment consulting business specified in Article 2 of these Measures without the permission of the CSRC shall be ordered to cease such activities by the local securities regulatory office (CSRC), and shall concurrently be subject to confiscation of illegal gains and a fine of not more than the value of the illegal gains.

Where a securities and futures investment consulting institution violates the provisions of Articles 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 28 of these Measures, it shall be subject to a single or concurrent penalty of a warning, confiscation of illegal gains, and a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan by the local securities regulatory office (CSRC); if the circumstances are serious, the local securities regulatory office (CSRC) shall report to the CSRC, and the CSRC shall impose a penalty of suspension or revocation of its business qualification; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Where a securities operating institution or futures brokerage institution violates the provisions of Article 26 of these Measures, it shall be ordered by the local securities regulatory office (CSRC) to make corrections, and shall concurrently be subject to a warning or a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan.

Where a securities and futures investment consultant violates the provisions of Articles 18, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 24 of these Measures, or fails to fulfill the reporting and annual inspection obligations to the securities regulatory authority as prescribed in these Measures, he or she shall be subject to a single or concurrent penalty of a warning, confiscation of illegal gains, and a fine of not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 30,000 yuan by the local securities regulatory office (CSRC); if the circumstances are serious, the local securities regulatory office (CSRC) shall report to the CSRC, and the CSRC shall impose a penalty of suspension or revocation of his or her business qualification; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Where staff members of the CSRC and local securities regulatory offices (CSRC) neglect their duties, abuse their powers, or engage in malpractice for personal gain, if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law; if no crime is constituted, administrative sanctions shall be given according to law.
These Measures shall come into force as of April 1, 1998.
